=== a headless session naming tools that need somebody there ===
$ oh -p --yolo -m opencode-go/fake -t read -t job -t weather -t wait a question
✗ A headless session offers only read, ls, find, grep, bash, write, edit, so it cannot offer job, weather, wait
[exit 1]
